levers.name: WPH-1 pre-stage diff
levers.reason: the drafts' window pre-stages about 148 verify input buffers a block, and only about 73 change from one round to the next; the block keeps the exact host value last written per destination (its pre-stage, its verify-time diff, its keyed write) and writes only the destinations whose new value is not bit-equal, under the per-block epoch invariant (any other writer kills the record)

levers.name: WPH-2 lean write_packed
levers.reason: write_packed reads every destination's addresses before and after every write and builds one mapper a value; the lean twin builds one mapper, captures the addresses at first sight and checks them once a round in the window, with the same uploads, copies, order and fence

levers.name: WPH-3 batched verify and collect read-backs
levers.reason: the verify readback (8 blocking per-shard reads a block) and the quad collect (34-40 a round, device idle) as one mesh-composed read per tensor (value 1) or non-blocking device-to-host copies into host tensors allocated once and one fence (value async); the per-chip tensors handed to the combine and merge code are the same bytes

profiles.reason: the host-gap instrument on the combined fusion arm and nothing else: per-round spans with wall against thread CPU, context switches, collections and the host calls (a blocked copy shows as a long single one), and a timed synchronize after the two quad launches every 16th eight-live round (2Q measured directly; probe rounds excluded from timing)

image_files.reason: WPH-1, imported lazily by verify_prestage.BlockPrestage under QWEN_FAST_PRESTAGE_DIFF (the resident record, the bit comparison, the audit); batched_reads_tp reuses its same_bits
WPH-2, imported lazily by verify_prestage.BlockPrestage under QWEN_FAST_WRITE_PACKED_LEAN (the lean writer and its address book)
WPH-3, imported lazily by packed_verifier.shard_predictions and quad_draft_tp.read_quad_outputs under QWEN_FAST_BATCHED_READS
WPH-4, imported lazily under QWEN_FAST_TP4_HOSTGAP_LOG by verify_prestage.hostgap_span, packed_verifier and the drafts' coordinator (spans, wrappers on the host calls, the probe)

card_jobs: scripts/ci/references/fusion-jobs/WPH/ (ORDER.txt): the one-card read probe first, the audited attaches on the combined arm, the timed ABAB, the instrumented run
notes: Hooks are env-gated inside files the package edits, so no tp_addresses row is needed: verify_prestage.py (BlockPrestage: the resident record, the writer choice, the span helper; the three modules are imported only with their flag set to anything but 0), packed_verifier.py (two small blocks: the batched verify readback and, under HOSTGAP_LOG, the instrument's install and two spans), quad_draft_tp.py (the batched collect), dflash_packed_proposal_coordinator.py (spans around the launches, the window, the fence and the collect; the probe after the launches), serving_worker_hook.py (phase spans), w2ln_timing_compare.py (a probe round is not a round time). Needs from the integrator, outside the generated blocks: nothing the branch has not already done: it adds the four modules to test_serving_image_copy_closure.C2_ONLY_PLAIN_IMPORTS and test_tp4_closure_literals.SERVED (one line each; merge them as unions) and it ran make_fusion_profiles.py --write and make_fusion_jobs.py --write so its own CPU run is green: after merging manifests REGENERATE, never hand-merge the fenced blocks. To bring the levers into fx-all add to WP0.json combined[0].levers the ids prestage-diff, lean and reads (the lever values are 1; reads=async if the card-M probe says so, via combined values), with audit flags already in the levers. KEYED (round_host) stays the verify-time half and this package the pre-stage half: PRESTAGE_DIFF records what KEYED wrote. PRESTAGE_BLOCK_EPOCHS is what lets a block's record survive the other block's round; in the global-epoch modes the other block's verify kills it and every pre-stage is the full one (still exact).
